title: Trust social media icons
slide_intent: Show how the institutional identity reads in a small circular profile image. The mark and ground must remain recognizable after a platform crops the square file.
strategic_value: Color variants of one trust seal can give Sheffield Museums a recognizable account identity across social platforms.
demonstration: The page groups several colorways of the circular trust icon. The notes specify 180 px square artwork that is commonly displayed with a circular crop.
practical_value: Use the trust profile artwork for an institutional account and check its contrast within the circular crop.
